title: Golf Shoe Bag – Nylon with Zipper
descriptionHtml:
Dirt in the trunk. Grass in the golf bag. Again.

The golf shoes do their job on the course – but then they have to come home. And suddenly the whole trunk smells of fairway.

The solution: a compartment of their own for the shoes

Toss the shoes in right after the round – the bag keeps the dirt in and the ventilation lets the moisture out, so the shoes are dry for the next round.

Features

  • The dirt stays in the bag – not in the trunk
  • The shoes dry between rounds – ventilated
  • Fits even large sizes
  • Handles being tossed around – hard-wearing nylon, heavy-duty zipper
  • Works just as well for the gym and travel
